record_type_quote: The major aim of the present study was to replicate two results of the study by Witmer et al. [ 27 ]: (1) the sensitivity of fNIRS recordings for measuring visuospatial WM-specific processes and (2) the moderating effect of mental ability on functional activation.

targets.title: The validity of functional near-infrared spectroscopy recordings of visuospatial working memory processes in humans.
targets.evidence_quote: The major aim of the present study was to replicate two results of the study by Witmer et al. [ 27 ]: (1) the sensitivity of fNIRS recordings for measuring visuospatial WM-specific processes and (2) the moderating effect of mental ability on functional activation.
targets.outcome_quote: Taken together, we successfully replicated two major findings reported by Witmer et al. [ 27 ].
